svg.title: Orange tile footprints aligned to blue outputs
svg.text: Orange placement — one Life cell, two perpendicular passes
Same scale throughout. L is the Life-cell width. Data ports sit at 0.2L, 0.4L, 0.6L, 0.8L on each axis.
Outer dotted square: Life-cell boundary. Inner work area: 0.8L × 0.8L. Orange outlines: proposed piece boundaries.
Each row has form (x, y, y, z).
Three unary bits + one C port per row.
Each body is 4L/5 long and L/5 wide.
The existing C column is bypassed.
The green outline marks the original centre channel.
The three new C ports along the bottom are auxiliary. They must not replace the original centre at the final rule tile.
Height still to resolve: the preserved C column is one layer below the newest outputs.
The post proposes raising the C end of the first orange pieces, or reaching down to it with a stepped final piece.
Fixed X blockers in the blue separator surround the work area. They carry no data and obstruct misplaced orange pieces.
These are dimensioned 2D port/footprint schematics. They do not yet specify C profiles or prove that wrong placements are impossible.
